Sub: Notification GSR 688(E) dated 26" September, 2008 deleting Para 12A and 13 of
EPS, 1995 and increasing the reduction factor for early pension from 3% to 4% —
Clarification with regard to the effective date of implementation.

Sir,

The Government of India while considering the huge actuarial deficit revealed by the
valuation reports has brought about certain amendments in Employees’ Pension Scheme, 1995
with an aim to reduce/remove the deficit. The above amendments have already been circulated
vide letter No. Coord.2(27)0S5/Amend/Scheme(Part) dated 16 October, 2008. By this
amendment the benefits of Commutation and Return of Capital(ROC) have been totally deleted ,
and the reduction factor for early pension has been increased from 3% to 4% with effect from 26™
September, 2008.

The date of implementation of the above amendments would be based on the date of
commencement of pension. To be more clear, all monthly member pension cases where the date
of commencement of pension is on or after 26-9-2008 would NOT be eligible for opting for
Commutation and ROC and reduction factor @ 4% will be applicable.

(This issues with the approval of Central Provident Fund Commissioner).

Yours faithfully,
a woe”
